audit.why: Lane difficulty is honestly framed: Swain bullies early/mid with Q poke and passive sustain, TF wins via 6+ map tempo. diff EVEN 5.5/10 matches 53.13% WR over 1532 games.
Spikes correctly named: Swain 3-5 (Q poke + E setup), Swain 6 (Demonic Ascension), TF first item (roam tempo), Swain late (stacked anchor). spikes[] has all 4 entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart carried blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content win[] correctly attributes Swain/TF; breakdown.cooldowns had no cooldown numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim.
audit.why: phases[N].side must agree with win[N]; Demonic Ascension is 120s, Nevermove 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — those numbers make the advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to content layer with matching whys and ratings; real cooldowns added; bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.

audit.why: Missing-interaction anti-heal vs Ravenous Flock is already covered in report[8] ('Add anti-heal early into his sustain').

edits.before: Q-farm from range and concede the duel question entirely — your level 1 is a wallet, not a weapon.
edits.after: Double-bolt Death's Hand plus Soul Fragment healing wins level 1 outright — Q-farm from range, concede it.

edits.before: W online: the gold card re-prices his every step-up. Lock yellow when he walks forward and the lane behaves.
edits.after: His Q poke and sustain still bully the wave, but gold card taxes his step-ups — lock yellow, give ground.

edits.before: Destiny online — THE level in this lane. Every shove is now a bot-lane death sentence with a 130-second timer.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension out-drains any level-6 lane fight he forces — spend Destiny cross-map, never brawl him at 6.

edits.before: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars. The lane still isn't the point — the map pays your salary.
edits.after: Lich Bane roam tempo outpaces an immobile Swain still stacking fragments — the map pays your salary now.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: A stacked Swain anchors every late fight and out-values your poke — play pick-and-collapse from range, never front him.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W gold card for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Swain Demonic Ascension: 120s — his drain mode; disengage when it starts and fight only on its downtime. - Nevermove is 12s at rank 1: when the root whiffs, that is your card-auto-Q window. Budget W for emergencies, R for opportunities.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Hold yellow for his walk-forward — stun the 850-range Nevermove step-up, chunk him, and back off before the root returns.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Destiny reaches 5500 units — a wave shoved into his tower is a free cross-map play; staying mid to poke an immortal Swain wastes it.

notes: Packet defect 'level chart contradicts data' resolved by aligning the full-layer sides (previously blanket Skill) to the content win[] rows, which are grounded: Swain wins early trades and 6/late lane fights, TF's 53.13% WR comes from first-item Destiny roam tempo — the chart measuring lane stages can favor Swain while TF wins games. suspectNames 'Demonic Ascension's' is a false positive (correct name, possessive). No win[] edits needed — content layer already correct; side edits alone per the chart rule.
